blocs: Hello! | My name is Lucy. | I' thirteen years old. | I live in London with my parents and my brother. | I love sports, but I don't like football. | My favourite activity is swimming. | I go swimming every Wednesday at half past four. | On Saturdays, I often go horse riding with my friend Emma. | We start at quarter past ten in the morning. | On Sundays, I usually stay at home. | I read comics or listen to music. | My brother Tom doesn't like sports. | He prefers playing computer games and watching films.

1.consigne: Écoute la phrase, puis choisis True (vrai) ou False (faux).

2.consigne: Écoute la question, puis chaque proposition, et clique sur la bonne réponse.

3.consigne: Choisis la bonne forme dans chaque menu.

4.consigne: Écoute la question et réponds en anglais (quelques mots ou une phrase).

fiche.consigne: Écoute le texte et note l'essentiel en mots-clés, en anglais si tu peux.
